findings.problem: The general separable-H schema calls a map on B(H) Schrödinger CPTP, and Definition 9.3 composes theta, defined only on A, with Phi|A without assuming Phi(A) subset A. The latter can be undefined even in finite dimension, so the new Proposition 9.5 does not yet establish a well-typed equivalence as written.
findings.repair: Use a Schrödinger CPTP map Phi:T1(H)->T1(H), its normal unital CP adjoint Phi*:B(H)->B(H), explicit invariance Phi*(A) subset A, and theta o Phi1*|A1 = Phi2*|A2 o theta. Require the invariance premise in P9.5; A=B(H) is always available. If a channel family is meant, impose/intertwine each t. Propagate typing to Sections 8.3, 10 and 13. Full ambient channel equality in P9.5 then proves the restricted equivalence.

It supplies neither an independent two-dimensional central selection nor the lift supporting fundamental matter representations.

A proposed SM Lie algebra requires explicitly selecting which two central directions are removed; the global group, finite-center quotient and matter-representation lift require separate premises or proof. Merely prefixing the current quotient argument with conditional does not fix it.

The adjacent remark also treats the unique W as freely normalizable to map reference vectors, which need not be possible.

Equality of the complete adjoint channels yields equal inner products; minimality gives a unitary intertwining A tensor I, hence I tensor W. The condition W|0_1>=|0_2> must be an extra hypothesis, not a selectable normalization. Clarify that equality of restricted observable dynamics on proper A is weaker than equality of the complete channel needed here.
